findings.explanation: Backend resultData omits recommended_actions and simulated_risk_score; PolicySimulationModel.fromJson silently falls back to recommendedActions=[] and simulatedRiskScore=3.2.

AI Service sends budget_estimate_idr, estimated_incident_reduction_pct, time_to_impact_weeks, and key_recommendations; PolicySimulationModel.fromJson looks for estimated_budget_idr, risk_reduction_pct, time_horizon_months, and recommended_actions, falling back to hardcoded defaults (1.5B IDR, 35.0%, 6 mos, []).

Backend POST /maps/route strips OSRM legs/steps and summary; RouteModel.fromBackendMapsJson hardcodes steps: [] and summary: "", breaking turn-by-turn street maneuver instructions in RoutePickerScreen and TtsService.

Backend GET /predictions/zones/{zoneId}/metrics returns data as Map {zone, metrics}, but PredictionRemoteDatasource.getZoneMetrics (prediction_remote_datasource.dart:43) checks if (json is List) and silently returns [] when json is Map.

findings.explanation: AI Service POST /v1/verify puts the human-readable rejection/review reason in description_auto and omits reason/rejection_reason, so AiVerificationResult.rejectionReason is always null.

ReportRemoteDatasource.submitReport (report_remote_datasource.dart:150-175) manually reconstructs ReportModel to attach localPhotoPath and omits rawAiConfidenceScore, damageSeverity, estimatedCompletionAt, directPriority, and progressPercentage.

findings.explanation: Backend AuthService passes message as a 1-element array on OTP_INVALID and OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN; HttpExceptionFilter overrides error.code to VALIDATION_ERROR and drops remainingSeconds.
